message:
I was chatting with my grandkids the other day about the importance of being ready for anything life throws our way. You know, little surprises like a sudden storm or a power outage. It reminded me of the time I put together our family’s emergency kit — it felt a bit silly at first, but now I can’t help but feel a bit smug when I see others scrambling during a weather event. 

Having a few essentials on hand really does make a difference, and it’s nice to know we’re prepared. Sometimes, it’s the little things that bring peace of mind. What’s one item you think every household should have in their kit?
